audience: cloud and DevOps teams that run Scaleway instances, DNS zones and managed databases

useCases.title: Check instance state and addresses
useCases.text: List the instances in a zone with their state, type and IP addresses. Open one instance to read its volumes, image and tags.

useCases.title: Review DNS zones and records
useCases.text: List the DNS zones you manage. Read the records of one zone, filtered by name or record type.

useCases.title: Review clusters and managed databases
useCases.text: List the Kubernetes Kapsule clusters of a region with their version. List the managed PostgreSQL or MySQL instances with their engine, status and node type.

useCases.title: Review security groups and load balancers
useCases.text: List the security groups, load balancers and block volumes of a zone, with their policies, status and attachments.

useCases.title: Start, stop or reboot an instance
useCases.text: Power an instance on, off or reboot it. A power off is a hard stop that can lose unsaved data, and billing continues while the instance runs.
